novel.justification: The condition retains all eight maps generated by independently responsive subsets of the three offered factors. By construction, these maps form the one-sided three-factor specialization, and hence a subclass, of Blackwell--Pashley's coordinate-specific receipt model; they are not the published class itself. Requiring this baseline prevents maximality within the present one-sided WARP ambient class from being manufactured by deleting ordinary one-sided compliance patterns.
